title: How to test with a local sandbox
description: Use this recipe to exercise IXOPAY SDK flows against a local sandbox API before testing against a shared or production-like gateway environment.
prerequisites: The IXOPAY PHP SDK installed with Composer.
A merchant integration that can switch gateway URLs outside production.

steps.title: Start the local sandbox API
steps.body: Run the sandbox router from this repository. It exposes transaction, status, redirect, test-credential, test-method, callback, and webhook replay endpoints for predictable scenarios.

steps.title: Point the SDK at the sandbox
steps.body: Use the SDK's configurable API URL in non-production code and send explicit payment-method and scenario headers.

steps.title: Run a transaction scenario
steps.body: Run one of the supported scenarios and inspect the redirect URL, status lookup, and callback payload.

code.content:
php examples/sandbox/debit.php redirect card
php examples/sandbox/debit.php card-3ds card
php examples/sandbox/debit.php mpesa-success mpesa
php examples/sandbox/debit.php mpesa-pending mpesa
php examples/sandbox/debit.php mpesa-timeout mpesa
php examples/sandbox/debit.php error card

validation: Redirect and card-3DS scenarios return a local hosted-payment redirect URL.
M-Pesa scenarios expose success, pending, and timeout behavior.
Error scenarios return a parsed SDK error object.
Status lookup returns a matching merchant transaction ID and sandbox scenario.
Callback payload endpoints include a signature generated from the sandbox shared secret.
